import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyCupOne
import MumfordLib.ExteriorPowerDuality

/-!
# Surjectivity of lattice group-cohomology alternation

For a finite free integral module, wedges of characters span the alternating
two-forms. Each wedge is the alternation of the corresponding group cup
cocycle, so the alternation map on actual group cohomology is surjective.
Injectivity remains a separate obligation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U] [Module.Free ℤ U] [Module.Finite ℤ U]

/-- Every integral alternating two-form on a finite free abelian group is
the alternation of an actual group-cohomology class. -/
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U)) := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  let e := exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U))) ≤
      (LinearMap.range (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U))).comap
        e.toLinearMap := by
    rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span ℤ 2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    change e (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ 2 f) ∈
      LinearMap.range (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U))
    refine ⟨groupCharacterCupClass (f 0).toAddMonoidHom (f 1).toAddMonoidHom, ?_⟩
    ext v
    rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass]
    simp [e, Matrix.det_fin_two, mul_comm]
  intro E
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective E
  exact htop (Submodule.mem_top : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℤ _))

/-- A chosen cohomology class whose alternation is a prescribed alternating form.

This is the (noncomputable) section obtained from the finite-free surjectivity
proof above.  It is useful when transporting an alternating form back to an
actual group-cohomology class rather than merely using membership in the range.
-/
noncomputable def groupSecondCohomologyAlternationSection
    : AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2) →
      groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) :=
  Function.surjInv (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_surjective (U := U))

@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_section_spec
    (E : AlternatingMap ℤ U ℤ (Fin 2)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationSection (U := U) E) = E := by
  exact Function.surjInv_eq (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_surjective (U := U)) E

theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_section_rightInverse :
    Function.RightInverse (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationSection (U := U))
      (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U)) := by
  intro E
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_section_spec (U := U) E

/-- A chosen group-cohomology class attached to an exterior square element. -/
noncomputable def groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection
    (x : ⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :
      groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternationSection
    ((exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2) x)

@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_exteriorSection_spec
    (x : ⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection (U := U) x) =
      (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2) x := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_section_spec (U := U)
    ((exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2) x)

/-! A decomposable exterior class has the expected determinant evaluation
under the chosen group-cohomology section. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_exteriorSection_ιMulti_apply
    (f : Fin 2 → Module.Dual ℤ U) (v : Fin 2 → U) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection (U := U)
          (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ 2 f)) v =
      Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j => f j (v i))) := by
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_exteriorSection_spec]
  exact exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv_ιMulti ℤ U 2 f v

/-! The exterior-power target is often more convenient than the equivalent
alternating-map target.  This map records that normalization explicitly. -/

/-- The alternation map with its target expressed as an exterior square of the
dual lattice. -/
def groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ]
      ⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U) := by
  letI : Module ℤ (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :=
    (⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)).module
  exact (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U))

@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior_section_spec
    (x : ⋀[ℤ]^2 (Module.Dual ℤ U)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior (U := U)
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection (U := U) x) = x := by
  change (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).symm
      (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation
        (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection (U := U) x)) = x
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_exteriorSection_spec]
  exact (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv ℤ U 2).symm_apply_apply x

/-- The exterior-power form of lattice alternation is surjective. -/
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior (U := U)) := by
  intro x
  exact ⟨groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExteriorSection (U := U) x,
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternationExterior_section_spec (U := U) x⟩

end Mumford.Analytic
